input.summary: Lumen Peptide Trading (V04), contact Jasper. Trader, not manufacturer: products made by partner plants in China and Korea. Claims OTIF 97%, rejection 0.5%, but no records yet (new in India); offered 2 Singapore references. Says suitable for cosmetics, ISO 9001 at manufacturer level, SDS to follow. Density of both solutions about 1.03. Latest reply: RM-008 rosemary grade is 20% carnosic acid and about 8% rosmarinic acid (HPLC). This does not meet our 20% rosmarinic acid spec; buyer decision needed. RM-009 COA shows 812 ppm vs 1,000 ppm quoted; still unresolved, 2 tries left. Outstanding knockouts: Q5 (COA per line), Q9 (SDS, leave-on suitability). Others: Q6, Q8. Reply due 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: RM-009 strength and outstanding mandatory documents
input.body:
Dear Jasper,

Thank you for your reply and the rosemary information.

RM-009 Copper Tripeptide-1 solution
1. The COA you sent shows 812 ppm peptide, while your quote states 1,000 ppm. Our spec is 1,000 ppm peptide. Please confirm the strength of the batch you would supply. If it is below 1,000 ppm, say so and send a COA for that batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.

Mandatory documents
2. A Certificate of Analysis for each line (RM-001 to RM-010) from a recent batch, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
3. The Safety Data Sheet for each line, and confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Other information
4. Your rejection rate over the last 12 months, and the certifications you hold (for example ISO 9001) with their expiry dates. Please state which of these apply to the manufacturing site.
5. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site for each line, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records for the last 12 months. The two Singapore references you offered would also help.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care

input.title: V04 Lumen: RM-008 rosemary extract does not meet spec
input.detail: Spec for RM-008 is 20% rosmarinic acid. Jasper (Lumen Peptide Trading) replied that the grade is 20% carnosic acid and about 8% rosmarinic acid by HPLC. This fails the spec. The earlier question was closed without an offer that meets it, and no further email on RM-008 has been drafted. Please decide whether to reject RM-008 from Lumen, accept a deviation, or source elsewhere. I have not promised anything to the vendor.
